title: Plan inputs, fee, change, and dust
description: A UTXO is an unspent piece of value. The planner selects enough pieces to cover amount plus estimated fee, then considers change and a dust threshold. Trace the UI request into buildUnsignedTransaction.
learning_objectives: Explain utxo selection, fee estimate, amount validation, and unsigned output construction in plain language.
Trace export function buildUnsignedTransaction in `src/wallet-core.ts` and explain the relevant behavior.

State and preserve this limit: The transaction is unsigned; fee size/rate assumptions are simplified, the change output currently uses an empty placeholder address, and no real payment should be made.
